subject: Custom connectivity retainer & premium onboarding — exec approval request
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@cloudmed.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: diego.ruiz@cloudmed.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: connectivity retainer + premium onboarding

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the resilience and KV caching behavior on long sequences. As we discussed, CloudMed is evaluating a year-long deployed offering where we need: 
- Private on-prem connector (appliance + VPN peering) to our primary datacenter
- Premium onboarding (2 onsite days + training for SREs)
- 24/7 priority support SLA for the duration of the retainer

We need a commercial proposal that bundles the above into a 12-month retainer with predictable unit economics. Our procurement target is $150k net first-year spend; to hit budget we need a concession on the one-time integration fees (we had ~60% budgeted for custom connectivity).

I've attached a draft SOW (v3) and a basic network diagram for the connector. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
1) include premium onboarding and waive the on-prem connector license for year one, and
2) provide a one-time onboarding credit to meet our $150k target?

If this requires an exception, please escalate — we can move quickly on a signed SOW + PO if terms are agreed this week.

Thanks,
Maria Santos
Director, Strategic Partnerships
CloudMed Health

Attachment: SOW_CloudMed_v3.pdf (application/pdf - 314KB)
Attachment: redwood-integration-network-diagram.png (image/png - 128KB)

To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: maria.santos@cloudmed.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: connectivity retainer + premium onboarding

Monica / Logan — quick escalation. CloudMed (large regional provider) is asking for a bundled 12-month retainer that includes a private on-prem connector + premium onboarding and 24/7 SLA. They are pressing to get to ~$150k net first year.

TL;DR: Their ask would normally be ~210K with standard integration/licensing + onboarding. They want us to include: 
- On-prem connector (appliance + VPN peering) — waive connector license for year 1
- 2 onsite onboarding days + recorded training (premium onboarding)
- 24/7 priority support (included in retainer)

Attachments: SOW_CloudMed_v3.pdf, pricing-summary.xlsx, network diagram.

Risk items to flag: custom connectivity implies network & compliance review, possible data flow restrictions (they're a B2B healthcare customer), and the margin hit if we waive the connector license. Finance/legal will need to sign the SOW redlines.

Ask: can we get an executive concession here? Suggested options: 
1) Approve one-time onboarding credit = $45k + waive connector license year 1 (restricted to first deployment only).
2) Approve limited onboarding credit = $25k, keep license fee but discount 50%.

If we go with option 1, I recommend we require: 
- Signed amendment (SOW) with liability caps preserved
- 6-month pilot clause with exit — if stability/ops metrics not met, revert to full license fees after the pilot

Maria can sign quickly if we commit. Please advise how far we can go.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: maria.santos@cloudmed.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: connectivity retainer + premium onboarding

Sean — thanks for the context and for pushing this forward. Reviewed the SOW and pricing matrix. My take: 

- Commercial: Approving the full waiver of the connector license and a $45k credit is a material concession (we'd be ~30% below list first-year ARR). We need an executive sign-off for that level of margin impact.
- Legal: Will require tightened indemnity and an explicit data handling addendum; we should not change liability caps.
- Ops/Delivery: Onsite days and the custom appliance are doable, but we should limit onsite to two days (as requested) and require remote follow-up hours pre-defined in the SOW.

Suggested approved path (fastest to close):
1) Approve a one-time onboarding credit of $35,000 and a 100% waiver of the connector license for year 1, conditional on:
   - CloudMed signs the amended SOW and the Data Processing Addendum (DPA)
   - A six-month pilot clause with performance SLAs (uptime/process metrics) and an auto-revert to standard pricing if metrics not met
2) If the customer insists on $45k credit, escalate to VP (Markus) for approval — provide a brief margin-impact memo.

Next steps: Sean — can you confirm whether CloudMed will accept the pilot clause? Also loop Legal (I'll thread them into the SOW redlines).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head, Sales Operations
monica_patel@redwood.ai

1) One-time onboarding credit: $45,000 (applied to first-year invoice) — APPROVED.
2) Connector license: waive for year 1 only, customer pays standard license thereafter.
3) Premium onboarding: 2 onsite days + 8 remote follow-up hours — included.
4) Conditions: 
   - CloudMed must sign amended SOW (SOW_v3A) with the Data Processing Addendum attached and standard liability caps unchanged.
   - Include a 6-month pilot clause with pre-agreed ops acceptance criteria (SLA thresholds).
   - Legal to sign off on redlines; Finance to record the concession for forecasting.

Sean — please prepare the SOW amendment (SOW_v3A) with the DPA and pilot clause, route to Legal for redlines, and push DocuSign. I'll inform Finance to note the $45K credit for ARR reconciliation.

Maria — thanks for moving quickly on this. If you confirm acceptance of the conditions, we'll have the amendment out by EOD tomorrow.
